controlled_live.alignment_rule: Both |normalized correlation| >= .1; slope within .005 of 1; no overflow. Unapproved pilot data-quality criterion.
controlled_live.privacy: Captured samples processed in memory and discarded. No audio file retained.
controlled_live.limitation: Synthetic acoustic playback surrogates, not human speech/taps or a known fan. Markers alone do not certify each stimulus audible. No live precision/recall without per-region review.

import importlib.util
from array import array
from dataclasses import replace

import far_audio_salience as f

assert importlib.util.find_spec('numpy') is None
cfg = f.DetectorConfig(f.ResourceLimits(1, 1, 4096, 8192, 1, 2, 100000, 1, 1), 0, 0, f.ResourceReporting(3, 8))
d = f.AudioSalienceDetector(cfg)
s = f.SourceSpec.microphone(label='clean wheel', sample_rate_hz=48000)
d.start_source(s)
b = d.process(s.chunk(memoryview(array('f', [0]*480)), first_frame=0))
assert b.salience[0].changes == ()
d.close()
print('Clean wheel: default ingestion/import passed without NumPy', f.__file__)
try:
    f.AudioSalienceDetector(replace(cfg, acoustic=f.AcousticConfig()))
except ValueError as e:
    assert '[dsp]' in str(e)
    print('Clean wheel: missing DSP error passed')
else:
    raise AssertionError('missing dependency silently accepted')
